items.headline: RBI Hikes Repo Rate by 25 Bps to 5.50%, Signals "Calibrated Tightening"
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% on October 7, the first hike in almost four years, shifting to a "calibrated tightening" policy. They also increased inflation forecast to 5.2% and FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7.1%.

items.headline: India's Consumer Inflation Expected to Rise to 5.40% in September, Weak Rupee Adds Pressure
items.summary: Consumer inflation is projected to climb to 5.40% in September from 4.82% in August, driven by higher food and energy costs. Core inflation is also expected to increase, further pressured by a weaker rupee near its all-time low.

items.headline: GST Council to Deliberate Scrapping Arrest Powers, Easing Registration for "GST 2.0"
items.summary: The GST Council is set to discuss significant policy reforms, including potentially removing GST officers' arrest powers and simplifying registration processes under "GST 2.0" to improve ease of doing business.

items.headline: Global Markets Dip as Rising US Treasury Yields and Inflation Concerns Weigh
items.summary: Global markets are showing weakness, with US markets closing lower due to rising Treasury yields and renewed inflation concerns. Asian markets are also mostly down today, indicating broad cautious sentiment.

items.headline: Brent Crude Prices Sustain Above $100/Barrel, Fueling India's Economic Worries
items.summary: Brent crude oil prices remain elevated above $100 per barrel, raising significant concerns over import costs, inflation, and the current account deficit for India's import-reliant economy.

items.headline: TCS Q2 FY27 Earnings Preview: Modest Sequential Growth Expected, Dividend Likely
items.summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is anticipated to report a modest sequential increase in Q2 FY27 revenue (1.2% QoQ to Rs 73,152 crore) and net profit (3.3% QoQ to Rs 13,794 crore), with a second interim dividend also expected.

items.headline: GM Breweries Reports Strong Q2 FY27 Results with 12.6% YoY Net Profit Increase
items.summary: GM Breweries announced a 12.6% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit for Q2 FY27, coupled with a 19.9% rise in revenue, signaling strong performance.

items.headline: IT Sector Shows Resilience Amidst Market Headwinds, Driven by TCS Earnings Focus
items.summary: Despite overall market weakness, the IT sector is experiencing some positive momentum, primarily driven by investor focus on Tata Consultancy Services' upcoming earnings and broader positive sectoral dynamics.

items.headline: Rate-Sensitive Sectors Under Pressure Post RBI Rate Hike; Banks Adjust Lending Rates
items.summary: Following the RBI's repo rate hike, rate-sensitive sectors, especially banking, are expected to face pressure. Several public sector banks have increased their Repo-Linked Lending Rates (RLLR) effective October 8, though HDFC Bank reduced its one-month MCLR.

items.headline: PTC Industries Launches QIP to Raise Rs 1,800 Crore at Floor Price of Rs 22,150
items.summary: PTC Industries has initiated a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) with a floor price of Rs 22,150 per share, aiming to raise up to Rs 1,800 crore to fund its expansion plans.

items.headline: Vedanta Declares First Interim Dividend of ₹5 per Share for FY27 Post-Demerger
items.summary: Vedanta has announced its inaugural interim dividend of ₹5 per share for the financial year 2027, following its recent demerger.

items.headline: Tata Power Partners Ocean Sun to Bring Membrane-Based Floating Solar Technology to India
items.summary: Tata Power has announced a partnership with Ocean Sun to introduce advanced membrane-based floating solar technology in India, enhancing its renewable energy portfolio.

items.headline: PC Jeweller Achieves Debt-Free Status, Reports 28% YoY Consolidated Revenue Increase
items.summary: PC Jeweller has successfully eliminated its debt burden and announced a robust 28% year-on-year increase in its consolidated revenue.

items.headline: Jubilant FoodWorks Reports 11.9% Year-on-Year Consolidated Revenue Growth in Q2
items.summary: Jubilant FoodWorks showcased strong performance in Q2, reporting an 11.9% year-on-year increase in its consolidated revenue.

content.outlook: The Indian market closed significantly lower, with NIFTY 50 shedding 1.75% and SENSEX down 1.47%. This broad-based weakness was underscored by extremely negative market breadth and substantial FII selling, which was partially absorbed by DIIs. Investors should prepare for continued volatility and sector-specific pressures given the widespread declines across most indices.
keyTakeaways: Nifty 50 and Sensex experienced sharp declines, closing down 1.75% and 1.47% respectively.
Market breadth was overwhelmingly negative with 6 advances against 52 declines.
Significant FII outflows of 6121.37cr were partially offset by DII buying of 4596.57cr.
Nifty Metal (-3.39%), Energy (-2.82%), Realty (-2.92%), and Pharma (-2.44%) were among the worst performing sectors.
The IT sector showed relative resilience, declining only 0.13%, with some IT stocks seeing minor gains.
ADANIENT.NS and JSWSTEEL.NS were among the top losers, while SRF.NS and select banking/IT stocks showed modest gains.
